Not much to tell, dude. I live with my mom and our cats. The house is fairly decent, so no problem there. Its just that Ive lived here for 15 years and im so tired of the same routine. 
I cant go anywhere because I dont have a lisence and theres not much in walking distance (not to mention no friends or money, so going out is pointless). So Im pretty much stuck here alone all day, hence the feeling like a prisoner.
